newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - More bids rolled out to March.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - More bids rolled out to March.

text.p: More basis bids for hard red winter wheat were rolled out to be calculated against the KCBT March contract, grain merchandisers in the High Plains said Friday.
Movement remained mostly sluggish, although some grain dealers reported seeing a little farmer-related selling.
Meanwhile, weather conditions for much of the Central Plains remained overcast Friday, and dealers said precipitation -- either snow or rain -- was in the forecast for Saturday and Sunday.
"We haven't seen more than two hours of sunshine over the last two weeks," said one northern Oklahoma dealer. "The wheat definitely needs the sun if it's gonna grow."
Basis values in cents/bu against KCBT wheat, cash=dollars/bu.
(Note: Z=KCBT December wheat futures. H=KCBT March wheat futures. unq- unquoted, na - not applicable)
